rows.label: tlk70000056_01_msg0001
rows.name:
I know! Driver weapons get stronger
the more you use them, right?

rows.label: tlk70000056_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Some start out with the power
of fire or water, too.

rows.label: tlk70000056_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Dad told me that choosing a Driver
weapon well and using it a lot are
both important.

rows.label: tlk70000056_01_msg0004
rows.name: Dad couldn't become a Driver, though.

rows.label: tlk70000056_01_msg0005
rows.name:
But he says becoming our dad was
enough for him! Cool, right?

rows.label: tlk70000056_01_msg0006
rows.name: He's a dad we can be proud of.
